title: Whole-system reduction preserves the actual integral open adjunction
statement: Fix D,C,E,n,S,o,z and invertibility of the coefficient prime as in [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. For a quasi-compact open immersion j:X -> Y use the natural pullComparison chi [def-sf-integral-proper-projection-coordinates] and extensionComparison rho [def-sf-integral-open-projection-coefficient-data]. If a is the actual datum open adjunction and b the actual system open adjunction, then for each constructible K on X, reduce_X(a.unit_K), chi_(j! K), and pull_j(rho_K) compose to b.unit_(reduce_X K). For each constructible N on Y, rho_(pull_j N), system j! of chi_N, and b.counit_(reduce_Y N) compose to reduce_Y(a.counit_N). No tensor, pullback compositor, or projection map appears.

proof.text: Restrict coherent reduction to the constructible category. Its fullness lifts any two arrows between reduced objects. If their finite evaluations agree, naturality of reductionEvaluation identifies the reductions of their lifts. Joint faithfulness of integral reductions identifies the lifts, hence the original arrows.

proof.text: Postcompose by the inverse of the pullback and open-extension comparisons so that the common target is reduced from a constructible integral object. Apply the first step to prove the unit equation. Expanding the mate and using this equation, naturality, and the right triangle identity identifies its inverse with extensionComparison. lean.statement:
theorem integralOpenAdjunctionReduction
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k))
    (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (j : X ⟶ Y)
    (hj : IsOpenImmersion j.hom.left) [QuasiCompact j.hom.left] :
    let a := S.higher.integral.openAdjunction j hj
    let b := (o.extension j.hom.left).adj
    let χ := pullComparison S.higher hl o z j
    let ρ := extensionComparison S hl o z j hj
    (∀ K, (reduce X).map (a.unit.app K) ≫
        χ.hom.app ((S.higher.integral.openExtension j hj).obj K) ≫
        (pull C.l E j.hom.left).map (ρ.hom.app K) = b.unit.app ((reduce X).obj K)) ∧
    (∀ N, ρ.hom.app ((S.higher.integral.pull j).obj N) ≫
        (Operations.shriek C.l E o j.hom.left).map (χ.hom.app N) ≫
        b.counit.app ((reduce Y).obj N) = (reduce Y).map (a.counit.app N))
